available: outer sandbox and launch arguments exist in runner source
startup output is reduced to fixed diagnostic categories
missing: persisted outer launch argv with redacted temporary paths
persisted raw or reproducibly redacted startup stderr
replay-time Electron Framework SHA-256 and build provenance
Chromium runtime-generated child profile or equivalent instrumented trace
readiness.exactGeneratedProfileCaptureBoundary: An app-level runner can persist its own outer argv, candidate identity, and bounded diagnostics, but the current audited source has no capture contract for Chromium's runtime-generated child profile. Obtaining that profile or an equivalent trace requires a separately authorized instrumented packaged run or an equivalent platform/runtime trace.

authorizedFollowUpRequirements: explicit approval for a packaged instrumented run and its exact candidate bundle
preserved executable and Electron Framework identity with source/build provenance
redacted outer and child launch argv plus bounded diagnostic capture
exact profile dump or an equivalent Chromium/OS trace, if technically available
exclusive evidence output, process-tree cleanup, rollback, and no external network access
conclusion: The current project has a partial diagnostic readiness contract but cannot produce replay-time exact generated profile evidence without a separately authorized instrumented packaged run or equivalent trace.
